one_line: Data center politics hit markets and firms, while AI spending stalls and Nvidia pushes new chips.

themes.title: Data center backlash reshapes policy and markets
themes.text: Asian AI-linked stocks plunged after U.S. midterms, where voters passed 40 of 41 ballot measures restricting data center development. OpenAI dropped NDAs with officials and pledged to pay full power costs, big tech and environmental groups began negotiating a national data center framework, and activists breached a Microsoft data center site in Amsterdam as protests spread across Europe.

stories.headline: Asian tech stocks plunge amid fears US Democrats may delay data centers
U.S. midterm elections bring voter backlash and new restrictions for AI data centers
OpenAI steps back from NDAs and promises full power costs for data centers
Big tech and environmental groups negotiate national data center framework
Activists breach Microsoft data centre site in Amsterdam as protests spread across Europe

themes.title: AI spending stalls as costs rise
themes.text: Ramp data shows AI spending flatlined over late summer, with token spend up just 1.5% across August and September versus 42% in July. Microsoft offered voluntary buyouts to about 60,000 employees as AI spending grows and ended its Oracle AI cloud rental over older Nvidia GPUs.

stories.headline: Ramp data shows AI spending stalling just as Anthropic nears its IPO
Microsoft offers voluntary buyouts to 60,000 employees as AI spending grows
Microsoft ends Oracle AI cloud rental as older Nvidia GPUs become obsolete

themes.title: Nvidia faces export scrutiny and tracking
themes.text: Democrats are preparing tighter oversight of Nvidia's chip export practices and circular financing arrangements. Nvidia is also requiring Southeast Asian cloud partners to enroll in a chip-tracking program to curb semiconductor smuggling, especially to China.

stories.headline: Democrats plan tighter oversight of Nvidia on chip exports and financing
Nvidia requires Southeast Asian cloud partners to enroll in chip‑tracking program

themes.title: Nvidia ships new simulation and agent hardware
themes.text: Nvidia released four open-weight Cosmos 3 Nano checkpoints for interactive world simulations and multi-sensor driving scenes. Its Vera CPU, which partners say runs agents 1.5-2.2x faster with up to 1.6x more agents per watt, targets higher agent throughput and better power efficiency.

stories.headline: Nvidia adds four open-weight Cosmos 3 Nano checkpoints for interactive simulation
Nvidia vera cpu offers higher agent throughput and better power efficiency
